description: Application for non-material amendment of planning permission dated 27/02/26 , ref: PA/25/01687Non Material Amendment(s) Sought:Amendments to the internal layouts, housing mix and landscaping of Phase 3 of the consented Bow Common development. The full details of the amendments are outlined in the Design and Access Statement (October 2026) and Landscape Strategy (October 2026) which accompanies this application. The following provides a summary of the proposed amendments.Minor amendments to the housing mix remaining within the approved housing mix ranges set out in condition 12;   Including the addition of eight duplex's;  Inclusion of residential amenity space at Level 1 in Building I;  Refining the setbacks on the elevations to improve fenestration, detailing and materiality, reflecting the revised layouts and proposed duplex layouts;  Enhanced horizontal fa‡ade detailing on Building I to define its identity further;  Internal layouts and cores updated to improve smoke ventilation, risers and buildability; and  Amendments to playspace provision.
